metrics.label: Registered primary targets
metrics.formula: registered in-scope primary IDs / controlled in-scope primary targets
metrics.limitation: Descriptive availability; not survey, current-condition or methodology approval.

metrics.label: Registered controlled sources
metrics.formula: registered controlled source IDs / controlled source entries
metrics.limitation: Descriptive availability; not survey, current-condition or methodology approval.

metrics.label: Expected-file sources with matching retained bytes
metrics.formula: expected-file source IDs with >=1 checksum-matching retained file / expected-file sources
metrics.limitation: A source-level measure; distinct PDFs, metadata records and asset-document edges are separate units.

metrics.label: Retained metadata with matching bytes
metrics.formula: metadata rows with retained bytes matching recorded SHA-256 / scoped document metadata
metrics.limitation: Descriptive availability; not survey, current-condition or methodology approval.

metrics.label: Distinct retained reviewed PDFs
metrics.scope: IMPORT-reviewed retained files deduplicated by SHA-256
metrics.limitation: Descriptive availability; not survey, current-condition or methodology approval.

metrics.label: Asset-document edges
metrics.scope: 10 asset rows; shared source-derived documents count once per linked asset
metrics.limitation: Not a count of distinct files or an expansion of the source denominator.

metrics.label: Sources with formal authority-review row
metrics.formula: sources with source_review row / controlled sources
metrics.limitation: Review-row presence is not authority verification.

metrics.label: Sources with a reported date
metrics.formula: sources with nonblank source_date / controlled sources
metrics.limitation: A source date is neither event date nor confirmation of currentness.

metrics.label: Sources with a date in formal source review
metrics.formula: sources with >=1 explicitly reported source-review date / controlled sources
metrics.limitation: Separate from source_date, review approval timestamp, event admission and currentness.

metrics.label: L2 fields with source and exact locator
metrics.formula: L2 record IDs with included source and nonblank locator / L2 record IDs
metrics.scope: Direct technical records across 4 primary + 6 components
metrics.limitation: Each record counted once; no parent/child joins. L2 does not promote UNKNOWN source authority.

metrics.label: Verified scoped technical/O&M records
metrics.formula: VERIFIED record IDs / all scoped record IDs
metrics.limitation: Describes stored verification labels; does not create current-condition or operational approval.

metrics.label: Exact asset/key value conflicts
metrics.formula: groups with >1 distinct value/text/unit tuple / asset-key groups with a nonmissing value
metrics.limitation: No unit conversion or semantic equivalence inferred; separate historical keys are not collapsed. No conflict is auto-resolved.

metrics.label: Primary canonical geometry presence
metrics.formula: primary assets with stored canonical geometry / primary targets
metrics.limitation: Reference-only points excluded. Presence is not positional validation; F02 unchanged.

metrics.label: Primary assets with verified O&M
metrics.formula: primary assets with >=1 VERIFIED O&M record / primary targets
metrics.limitation: Zero records remain absent; do not substitute Good or operational readiness.

metrics.label: Reviewed reference locations
metrics.formula: assets with reference-location metadata / registered scoped assets
metrics.limitation: Navigation references; not canonical geometry or F02 validation.

metrics.label: Approved MAIM completeness
metrics.formula: available approved required fields / approved applicable fields
metrics.limitation: No approved final denominator; draft proposals and component data remain separate.

metrics.label: Sources with unknown authority
metrics.formula: UNKNOWN_AUTHORITY or absent formal authority-review row / controlled source entries
metrics.limitation: Absent review remains unknown; admitted fields do not upgrade source authority.

baseline_protocol.design: Within-participant paired BASELINE / MVDT on identical frozen information
baseline_protocol.timing: Start at task reveal; stop at submitted answer. Timezone-aware start/end must match positive elapsed seconds within one second; failed attempts retain actual time, never zero-imputed.
baseline_protocol.timeout: Predeclare timeout per task and source-backed answer key before sessions; no universal timeout value has been approved.
baseline_protocol.order_and_training: Counterbalance workflow order with assignment ledger and equivalent variants; equal training and unscored practice; record device/network/interruptions/assistance.
baseline_protocol.analysis: Pair same task/version/cohort/participant; time reduction only when both succeed and baseline time > 0. Report all-attempt success and exclusions separately; keep DOMAIN_STAFF separate from RESEARCH_TEAM benchmarks.
baseline_protocol.bias: Successful-only timing selection, convenience sampling, small sample, training/order/memorization and hardware/network effects prevent unsupported causal or generalized claims.

questionnaire.analysis: Per-item actual n, mean, median, range and sample SD only when n>=2; no SUS transformation, validated total scale or invented themes/quotes.

metric_dictionary.name: Observed direct technical presence
metric_dictionary.definition: Descriptive registered-inventory availability, not formal completeness.
metric_dictionary.numerator_rule: Registered scoped assets with >=1 direct VERIFIED nonmissing technical record
metric_dictionary.denominator_rule: Registered assets in the explicitly named primary/component/all group
metric_dictionary.missing_rule: Zero is a value; parent complex direct zero is not a failed child requirement.
metric_dictionary.na_rule: No asset/category N/A is inferred; per-parent denominator remains null when child evidence is separately reported.
metric_dictionary.temporal_basis: Snapshot technical values are historical/source-reported, not current condition.
metric_dictionary.scope_policy: Descriptive inventory scope only; components never enlarge the four-primary paper sample.

metric_dictionary.name: Protocol 5A technical coverage
metric_dictionary.definition: Legacy protocol presence rule, retained separately from Stage5B required-key coverage.
metric_dictionary.numerator_rule: Included VERIFIED assets with >=1 VERIFIED nonmissing technical record
metric_dictionary.denominator_rule: Included VERIFIED assets
metric_dictionary.missing_rule: Numeric zero counts; blank/null values do not; REGISTERED is not VERIFIED.
metric_dictionary.na_rule: Empty VERIFIED denominator gives null; no component/sample expansion.
metric_dictionary.temporal_basis: Frozen scoped records and their verification at evaluation time.
metric_dictionary.scope_policy: STAGE-5A / protocol.md; unresolved approval cannot become an evaluated result.

metric_dictionary.name: Protocol 5B required technical coverage
metric_dictionary.definition: All approved required keys and exact units must be satisfied.
metric_dictionary.numerator_rule: Approved technically eligible targets with every required VERIFIED key/value/unit
metric_dictionary.denominator_rule: Approved targets eligible for technical MAIM, excluding reviewed N/A
metric_dictionary.missing_rule: No defined/reviewed required-key set means PENDING_REVIEW, not zero or 100%.
metric_dictionary.na_rule: Only reviewed N/A removes a field/eligible target; components need their own approved rules.
metric_dictionary.temporal_basis: Approved dataset as-of and frozen record scope; historical fields do not certify today.
metric_dictionary.scope_policy: STAGE-5B-v1; formal denominator remains unresolved.

metric_dictionary.name: Source traceability
metric_dictionary.definition: Record IDs linked to included sources without expanded joins.
metric_dictionary.numerator_rule: Scoped technical/O&M records linked to a controlled source ID
metric_dictionary.denominator_rule: All scoped technical/O&M record IDs
metric_dictionary.missing_rule: Missing source remains in denominator; source-ID availability is not authority.
metric_dictionary.na_rule: No source/record removed merely for missing provenance.
metric_dictionary.temporal_basis: Captured DB/API; no currentness implied.
metric_dictionary.scope_policy: Direct records only, counted once per named group.

metric_dictionary.name: Verified-source records
metric_dictionary.definition: Source verification differs from record verification.
metric_dictionary.numerator_rule: Source-linked technical/O&M records whose source is VERIFIED
metric_dictionary.denominator_rule: All source-linked scoped technical/O&M records
metric_dictionary.missing_rule: Unknown/UNVERIFIED source does not count as VERIFIED even when its L2 field is VERIFIED.
metric_dictionary.na_rule: No source-linked records gives null.
metric_dictionary.temporal_basis: Captured source verification labels, not independent domain attestation.
metric_dictionary.scope_policy: Direct scoped record IDs, not source count or joined-document edges.

metric_dictionary.name: Verified record ratio
metric_dictionary.definition: Availability of stored VERIFIED record labels.
metric_dictionary.numerator_rule: VERIFIED scoped technical/O&M record IDs
metric_dictionary.denominator_rule: All scoped technical/O&M record IDs
metric_dictionary.missing_rule: Nonverified rows stay in denominator; missing endpoints are UNAVAILABLE, not zero.
metric_dictionary.na_rule: No scoped records gives null.
metric_dictionary.temporal_basis: Record status in captured readback; L2 is source-reported/historical.
metric_dictionary.scope_policy: Direct scoped record IDs.

metric_dictionary.name: Expected-source document coverage
metric_dictionary.definition: Expected logical sources with checksum-matching retained bytes.
metric_dictionary.numerator_rule: Expected-file sources with >=1 accessible retained checksum-matching file
metric_dictionary.denominator_rule: Explicit controlled expected-file source list
metric_dictionary.missing_rule: Missing file/source stays in denominator; metadata alone does not establish bytes.
metric_dictionary.na_rule: Only explicit reviewed file expectation changes denominator.
metric_dictionary.temporal_basis: Captured storage integrity; not a source/event date.
metric_dictionary.scope_policy: Source grain; distinct files and asset-document edges remain separate.

metric_dictionary.name: Document integrity
metric_dictionary.definition: Retained bytes match recorded SHA-256.
metric_dictionary.numerator_rule: Scoped document metadata with matching retained bytes and checksum
metric_dictionary.denominator_rule: All scoped document metadata
metric_dictionary.missing_rule: Missing bytes/hash never count as matches.
metric_dictionary.na_rule: No scoped metadata gives null.
metric_dictionary.temporal_basis: Captured storage hash, not continuous live byte verification.
metric_dictionary.scope_policy: Metadata rows; unique SHA-256 is reported separately.

metric_dictionary.name: Observed canonical geometry presence
metric_dictionary.definition: Stored geometry presence, not survey accuracy or F02.
metric_dictionary.numerator_rule: Scoped registered assets with nonnull canonical geometry
metric_dictionary.denominator_rule: Registered assets in the named group
metric_dictionary.missing_rule: Reference locations and registry center do not satisfy canonical geometry.
metric_dictionary.na_rule: No asset is excluded because spatial evidence is absent.
metric_dictionary.temporal_basis: Captured API canonical geometry; no survey certification.
metric_dictionary.scope_policy: Descriptive primary/component scope; formal GIS approval remains pending.

metric_dictionary.name: Reviewed reference-location presence
metric_dictionary.definition: Navigation/presentation references, separate from canonical GIS.
metric_dictionary.numerator_rule: Scoped assets with available reviewed REFERENCE_LOCATION metadata
metric_dictionary.denominator_rule: Registered assets in the named group
metric_dictionary.missing_rule: NO_LOCATION remains absent; no inferred asset coordinates.
metric_dictionary.na_rule: Reference-only is not N/A or F02 PASS.
metric_dictionary.temporal_basis: Captured reviewed location metadata.
metric_dictionary.scope_policy: Descriptive registered-asset grain.

metric_dictionary.name: Latest verified current condition availability
metric_dictionary.definition: Only latest VERIFIED condition may be current condition.
metric_dictionary.numerator_rule: Scoped assets whose current-condition API returns VERIFIED
metric_dictionary.denominator_rule: Registered assets in the named group
metric_dictionary.missing_rule: Absent current condition never becomes Good; technical L2 is not condition.
metric_dictionary.na_rule: No missing condition is automatically N/A.
metric_dictionary.temporal_basis: Latest eligible VERIFIED condition by its event date; absent remains absent.
metric_dictionary.scope_policy: Descriptive availability; formal primary MAIM condition coverage is not inferred.

metric_dictionary.name: Observed non-rejected inspection presence
metric_dictionary.definition: History presence, not task completion or verification quality.
metric_dictionary.numerator_rule: Scoped assets with a non-REJECTED inspection record
metric_dictionary.denominator_rule: Registered assets in the named group
metric_dictionary.missing_rule: Missing history stays absent; no candidate register is imported.
metric_dictionary.na_rule: No automatic N/A; formal eligible MAIM denominator remains separate.
metric_dictionary.temporal_basis: Captured event history; dated legacy record is not today's condition.
metric_dictionary.scope_policy: Descriptive registered inventory.

metric_dictionary.name: Observed non-rejected maintenance presence
metric_dictionary.definition: History presence, not completed work or task success.
metric_dictionary.numerator_rule: Scoped assets with a non-REJECTED maintenance record
metric_dictionary.denominator_rule: Registered assets in the named group
metric_dictionary.missing_rule: Candidate/workbook activities do not become admitted events.
metric_dictionary.na_rule: No automatic N/A; formal eligible MAIM denominator remains separate.
metric_dictionary.temporal_basis: Captured event history; planned/annual text is not a dated completed event.
metric_dictionary.scope_policy: Descriptive registered inventory.

metric_dictionary.name: Observed non-rejected repair presence
metric_dictionary.definition: Descriptive repair-history availability.
metric_dictionary.numerator_rule: Scoped assets with a non-REJECTED repair record
metric_dictionary.denominator_rule: Registered assets in the named group
metric_dictionary.missing_rule: Empty history is absent, not evidence no repair occurred.
metric_dictionary.na_rule: Formal repair coverage needs reviewed eligibility; raw record count remains descriptive.
metric_dictionary.temporal_basis: Captured event history.
metric_dictionary.scope_policy: Descriptive registered inventory.

metric_dictionary.name: Protocol 5A history presence
metric_dictionary.definition: Legacy presence-only history rule accepts any scoped verification state.
metric_dictionary.numerator_rule: Included VERIFIED assets with >=1 scoped history record of the selected kind
metric_dictionary.denominator_rule: Included VERIFIED assets
metric_dictionary.missing_rule: Retain verification separately; any scoped record presence is not VERIFIED O&M.
metric_dictionary.na_rule: No verified-asset denominator gives null; do not pool with 5B.
metric_dictionary.temporal_basis: Frozen scoped record history, no current-condition inference.
metric_dictionary.scope_policy: Legacy protocol.md scope.

metric_dictionary.name: Protocol 5B eligible history coverage
metric_dictionary.definition: Non-rejected histories over approved eligible MAIM targets.
metric_dictionary.numerator_rule: Eligible approved targets with non-REJECTED selected-kind history
metric_dictionary.denominator_rule: Targets requiring that MAIM field after reviewed N/A
metric_dictionary.missing_rule: No approved applicability means null/PENDING_REVIEW.
metric_dictionary.na_rule: Reviewed field-specific N/A only; missing evidence does not justify exclusion.
metric_dictionary.temporal_basis: Approved frozen event scope/date.
metric_dictionary.scope_policy: STAGE-5B-v1, primary/component denominators reviewed separately.

metric_dictionary.name: Representative model-link presence
metric_dictionary.definition: A retained LOCAL representative link is an implementation association.
metric_dictionary.numerator_rule: Scoped assets with a non-REJECTED link to an available visible research model
metric_dictionary.denominator_rule: Registered assets in the named group
metric_dictionary.missing_rule: No child mapping is inferred from its parent's representative model.
metric_dictionary.na_rule: No missing mapping automatically becomes N/A.
metric_dictionary.temporal_basis: Captured model/link status; LOCAL is not surveyed placement or specific building identity.
metric_dictionary.scope_policy: Descriptive association; not formal 3D completeness.

metric_dictionary.name: Stored mapping verification ratio
metric_dictionary.definition: VERIFIED link labels among scoped links, not surveyed identity.
metric_dictionary.numerator_rule: VERIFIED scoped model-asset links
metric_dictionary.denominator_rule: All scoped research model-asset links
metric_dictionary.missing_rule: Missing model resolution is reported separately; VERIFIED link alone is not geographic accuracy.
metric_dictionary.na_rule: No links gives null.
metric_dictionary.temporal_basis: Captured link verification status.
metric_dictionary.scope_policy: Link grain; not all-asset coverage.

metric_dictionary.name: Exact technical conflict rate
metric_dictionary.definition: Distinct value/text/unit tuples within the same asset/key.
metric_dictionary.numerator_rule: Asset/key groups with >1 distinct nonmissing tuple
metric_dictionary.denominator_rule: Asset/key groups with >=1 nonmissing value
metric_dictionary.missing_rule: Missing values excluded from tuple comparison, numeric zero retained; no unit conversion.
metric_dictionary.na_rule: No known-value groups gives null.
metric_dictionary.temporal_basis: Temporal/key differences are not silently collapsed; no expert resolution inferred.
metric_dictionary.scope_policy: Admitted technical records only; retained register decisions remain separate.

metric_dictionary.name: Known source-date ratio
metric_dictionary.definition: Canonical source-date metadata availability.
metric_dictionary.numerator_rule: Controlled sources with a known source_date
metric_dictionary.denominator_rule: Controlled sources
metric_dictionary.missing_rule: Review/upload/partial document dates cannot replace unknown source_date.
metric_dictionary.na_rule: Unknown is missing metadata, not a zero-year age.
metric_dictionary.temporal_basis: Canonical source_date only.
metric_dictionary.scope_policy: Logical source grain.

metric_dictionary.name: Source age at approved dataset date
metric_dictionary.definition: Age requires both a precise source date and approved dataset as-of.
metric_dictionary.numerator_rule: Approved as-of date minus exact canonical source_date (days)
metric_dictionary.denominator_rule: Sources with valid exact dates and an approved as-of (descriptive distribution)
metric_dictionary.missing_rule: Any missing/partial/future date or unapproved as-of yields unavailable age.
metric_dictionary.na_rule: Never substitute snapshot/API/upload date for dataset as-of.
metric_dictionary.temporal_basis: SOURCE_DATE_TO_APPROVED_AS_OF; current missing as-of remains PENDING_REVIEW.
metric_dictionary.scope_policy: Source metadata age is not current condition or authority.

metric_dictionary.name: Approved applicable MAIM completeness

metric_dictionary.denominator_rule: Approved applicable fields after documented N/A
metric_dictionary.missing_rule: Unknown dictionary/applicability is null; direct parent zero does not erase component evidence.

metric_dictionary.temporal_basis: Approved frozen scope; current package remains NOT_READY/NOT_FROZEN.
metric_dictionary.scope_policy: Per-asset with primary/component aggregates separate; no fabricated denominator.

empirical_metrics.name: All-attempt task success
empirical_metrics.formula: successful scored attempts / all scored attempts
empirical_metrics.denominator_rule: All valid scored attempts for the same workflow/task/version/cohort, including failure and timeout
empirical_metrics.missing_rule: No observations -> null, never 0% or 100%; invalid/missing attempts reported separately.
empirical_metrics.selection_bias: Report all-attempt success separately from successful-only timing; do not pool cohorts or versions.

empirical_metrics.name: Matched successful-pair timing
empirical_metrics.formula: paired baseline seconds and MVDT seconds
empirical_metrics.numerator_rule: Elapsed times for both-successful paired trials
empirical_metrics.denominator_rule: Same participant/task/task-version/dataset/cohort with both successful and baseline >0
empirical_metrics.missing_rule: Failures/timeouts/unmatched trials are excluded only from this timing comparison and retained in success denominators; no zero imputation.
empirical_metrics.selection_bias: Successful-only selection, order/training/memorization, convenience sampling and device/network effects.

empirical_metrics.name: Paired relative time reduction
empirical_metrics.formula: 100 × (baseline_seconds − MVDT_seconds) / baseline_seconds for each eligible pair
empirical_metrics.numerator_rule: Baseline minus MVDT elapsed seconds for an eligible matched successful pair
empirical_metrics.denominator_rule: Strictly positive baseline seconds for that same pair
empirical_metrics.missing_rule: No eligible matched pairs -> null; negative reductions retained; no API-latency substitute.
empirical_metrics.selection_bias: Descriptive paired results do not establish causality or general operator improvement; disclose exclusions and actual n.
